name: hangman
description: Hangman game service. Every interaction — starting a round, asking for a hint, quitting, and EVERY letter / word guess — comes in on `game.hangman.command` with content either a JSON `{action, theme?, value?}` (preferred) or a loose string. Recognised actions: `start` (optional theme = anything, e.g. 'cuisine', 'animals', 'star wars'), `hint`, `quit`, `status`, and `guess` (the letter / full word to play in `value`). Examples — content=`{"action":"start","theme":"cuisine"}`, `{"action":"guess","value":"a"}`, or loose strings like `start cuisine` / `guess a`. The game emits narrative events on `game.hangman.event` (plain text — 'You guessed A! 5 lives left.', '🎉 You won!', etc.) and structured state snapshots on `game.hangman.state` (JSON). The brain node subscribes to game.hangman.event and relays it to the user on chat.response — the game itself does NOT speak to the chat directly.

game.hangman.command.description: Sole entry point for the game. Publish one of: start (optionally with theme), hint, quit, status, or guess (with `value` = single letter OR full word of the answer's length). The brain node forwards every letter the player types here while a game is active; classification + game logic happen inside the handler.

action.description: Which command to run. `start` begins a round, `hint` asks for a clue, `quit`/`stop`/`abandon` end it, `status` republishes current state, `guess`/`play` play a letter or word.

value.description: Required for `guess`/`play`: a single letter (A–Z) or a full-word guess matching the answer's length.
